kamloops.title: Vancouver police release video of violent robbery of 75-year-old man
kamloops.description: The victim was attacked on Tuesday morning while going for a walk near East Hastings Street and Jackson Avenue in the Downtown Eastside.

all.title: B.C. firefighters face critical days as dry fuels and winds increase fire risks
all.description: A cold front with gusty winds could bring extreme fire behaviour in areas where British Columbia communities are threatened by wildfires.

all.title: Sawmill closures ‘gut-wrenching’ amid lumber industry headwinds: Canfor CEO
all.description: The Fox Creek, Alta. sawmill is closing because there's not enough fibre in the region to sustain it long-term, coupled with U.S. tariffs and weak markets, the company said.

all.title: Former NHLer Tood Warriner to coach Windsor women
all.description: Former NHL player Todd Warriner has been named interim head coach of the University of Windsor's women's hockey team.
